title: 第5章 你的哥哥很好现在是我的哥哥了第6章 栖梧随侍
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
自测灵大典结束已有数日，云擎深居简出，多数时间都留在擎宇殿巩固修为。偶尔，云烁会眼巴巴地跑来贴贴，云擎心情尚可时，也会指点他一二。
清晨，擎宇殿后方演武场，枪影如风雷激荡。
云擎一袭玄白二色的劲装束紧腰身，长枪在他手中如惊雷破阵，迸发千钧之力。衣袂翻飞间，金石地面上留下一道道密密麻麻的枪痕。持枪的手腕翻出一道利落的弧光，枪杆顺势贴背滑行，环形气浪轰然扩散，随即旋身收枪，枪尖斜指地面。
“大哥好厉害！”场边云烁看得目不转睛，小脸因兴奋而涨红，眼神中满是崇拜。
云擎唇角弯起一丝温和的弧度，正欲开口指点幼弟几句——
“轰！”
一股浩瀚冰冷的恐怖威压，骤然降临！
演武场上空气瞬间凝滞，翻飞的尘土诡异地定格在半空。光线扭曲，一道由纯粹神力凝聚的月白身影，悄无声息地出现在场边。
来者面容与云煌一般无二，只是那双淡金色的眼瞳，比本尊更多了几分近乎无情的冷意，这竟是一具分身。
他先扫了云烁一眼，当目光落下时，云烁只觉得像是被什么可怖存在盯住了一般，浑身发僵，连呼吸都乱了。随后，那道视线才落到云擎身上。
“少、少君！”云烁双腿一软，噗通跪倒在地，声音抖得不成样子。
云煌并未理会他，声音平缓，却带着天道律令般的威严，每一个字都敲在二人的心弦之上：“我云氏子弟，皆朝秉丹曦炼真炁，暮伴星轨悟玄章。晨课乃筑基之本，何人给你的胆子，敢在此处耽于嬉闹？”
他说话时，目光落在云烁身上，可那无形的压力却如同潮水般向云擎涌去。问责云烁是假，敲打云擎，才是真。
云擎心中明镜，以少君的尊贵身份，岂会亲自过问一个庶子是否逃课？这分明是借题发挥。
他不动声色地上前一步，将瑟瑟发抖的云烁挡在身后，隔绝了那令人窒息的威压。随后躬身行礼，姿态无可挑剔：
“云擎，见过少君。”他声音沉稳，不见波澜，“是擎督导不力，未及时规劝七弟前往晨课，懈怠了修行，一切罪责在擎。”
他将所有责任揽到自己身上，没有辩解求情，干脆地“认罪”了。
云煌眼底闪过一丝极淡的讶异，随即被更深的玩味取代。不反抗，不狡辩，甚至主动将把柄递过来？这份“恭顺”，是真心臣服，还是以退为进的隐忍？
他唇角勾起一抹没有温度的弧度，周遭空气又寒冷了几分，“你是督导不力。依族规，此过当受戒鞭十记，并罚没三月修炼资源。”
云煌目光如鹰隼般紧锁云擎，不放过他任何一丝细微的表情变化。

戒鞭！
远处那些原本不敢多看的仆从，此刻也都暗暗变了脸色。云氏责罚子弟的戒鞭，是由“清心藤”主枝混合“破罡金”炼制而成，专破护体灵力，一鞭下去皮开肉绽伤及经脉不说，鞭痕更会附着“问心”之力，不断折磨受罚之人的心神。
十鞭下去，莫说云烁这样的小孩，便是寻常修士都未必扛得住。这惩罚，不可谓不狠辣。
content_en:
It has been several days since the Spirit Testing Ceremony ended. Yun Qing is living in seclusion and spends most of his time in Qingyu Hall to consolidate his cultivation. Occasionally, Yun Shuo would come eagerly to post some tips, and when Yun Qing was in a good mood, she would give him some pointers.
In the early morning, at the martial arts field behind Qingyu Hall, the shadows of guns were surging like wind and thunder.
Yun Qing was dressed in black and white attire, tightly tied around his waist, and the spear in his hand was like thunder breaking through the formation, bursting out with tremendous power. As his clothes flew around, dense gun marks were left on the stone ground. The wrist holding the gun made a sharp arc, and the gun barrel slid against the back. The circular air wave suddenly spread, and then he turned around and retracted the gun, pointing the gun tip diagonally at the ground.
"Brother is so awesome!" Yun Shuo watched intently from the sidelines, her face flushed with excitement, her eyes full of admiration.
The corners of Yun Qing's lips curved in a gentle arc, and he was about to give some instructions to his younger brother——
"Boom!"
A vast, cold, terrifying pressure suddenly descended!
The air in the martial arts arena instantly stagnated, and the flying dust was strangely frozen in mid-air. The light was distorted, and a moon-white figure condensed by pure divine power appeared quietly on the sidelines.
The face of the visitor was the same as that of Yun Huang, but the pale golden eyes were a little more cold and almost ruthless than the original one. This was actually a clone.
He glanced at Yun Shuo first. When his gaze fell, Yun Shuo felt as if he was being stared at by some terrifying existence. His whole body was stiff and even his breathing was messed up. Then, the line of sight fell on Yun Qing.
"Young Master!" Yun Shuo's legs went weak and he fell to his knees, his voice trembling.
Yunhuang ignored him, his voice was gentle, but with the majesty of heaven's law, every word hit the heartstrings of the two of them: "I, the children of the Yun family, all practice their true energy by the Danxi in the morning, and understand the mysterious chapter by the star track in the evening. Morning classes are the foundation of building a foundation. Who gave you the courage to indulge in frolics here?"
When he spoke, his eyes fell on Yun Shuo, but the invisible pressure surged towards Yun Qing like a tide. It is false to hold Yun Shuo accountable, but it is true to beat Yun Qing.
Yun Qing had a clear idea in his mind. With his noble status as a young master, how could he personally ask a concubine whether he skipped classes? This is obviously a pretext.
He calmly took a step forward, blocking the trembling Yun Shuo behind him, blocking out the suffocating pressure. Then he bowed and saluted with impeccable posture:
"Yun Qing, I've met Young Master." His voice was calm and without any waves, "It was Qing who failed to supervise him well and failed to persuade his seventh brother to go to morning classes in time. He slacked off in his practice. Qing is responsible for all the crimes."
He took all the responsibility on himself and simply "confessed" without any excuse or plea.
A faint hint of surprise flashed in Yunhuang's eyes, which was immediately replaced by deeper amusement. Not resisting, not making excuses, and even taking the initiative to hand over the handle? Is this "submission" true surrender, or is it forbearance in order to retreat?
The corners of his lips curled up in a cold arc, and the air around him became a bit colder. "You are a poor supervisor. According to the clan rules, you will be punished with ten lashes and three months of training resources will be confiscated."
Yunhuang's eyes were locked on Yunqing like a hawk, not letting go of any slight change in his expression.
Whip it!
The servants in the distance who did not dare to look at him at first also secretly changed their expressions at this moment. The whip used by the Yun family to punish his disciples is made from the main branch of the "Qingxin Vine" mixed with "Po Gang Gold". It is specially designed to break the spiritual power of protecting the body. With one whip, it will tear open the skin and bruise the meridians. The whip marks will also be attached with the power of "asking the heart", constantly torturing the mind of the person being punished.
Not to mention a child like Yun Shuo, even ordinary monks may not be able to bear ten lashes. This punishment is not cruel.
